statement.p: Find the volume under the graph of the function f(x,y) = 10 x^2 y over the region shown in the figure below.

static.solution: x = 3, x = 5, y = 12, and y = 4 x. Thus \mbox{vol } = \int_{3}^{5}\int_{12}^{4 x} 10 x^2 y\,dy\,dx. To evaluate this integral, we evaluate the inside integral first: \int_{12}^{4 x} 10 x^2 y\,dy = 5 x^2 y^2\bigg|_{12}^{4 x} = 5 (16 x^4 - 144 x^2). Therefore, we have \int_{3}^{5} \int_{12}^{4 x} 10 x^2y\, dy\, dx = \int_{3}^{5} (80 x^4 - 720 x^2)\,dx = \left(16 x^5 - 240 x^3\right)\bigg|_{3}^{5} = 22592. The volume of this object is 22592.
